title: Daily run 2026-11-02 (exact Oct 29 - Nov 1; Nov 2 so far from hourly data)

sections.h: Biggest change: Uber SMS shifted signature and is getting through
items: Uber SMS (Key 1): the grease/pagebio wave fell from 2.1M/day (Oct 28) to 75k on Nov 1, but it reappeared on other signatures with high verified share: pragma + upcoming-Chrome 175k on Nov 1 at 91% verified; spoofed-OS + pagebio + GREASE 42k on Nov 1 at 62% verified (8.9-13k/hour at 00-02 UTC with 6.9-12k verified per hour).
Discovery NEW-1 (rfc ct-before-cl + di-short-300-pxr1): 2.81M Uber SMS sessions in Oct 29 - Nov 1 at 46% verified; only 8% already flagged by a live TT. Biggest gap found this run.
Amazon IDS (Key 2): grease 2.05M Oct 30 / 2.76M Oct 31 / 0.94M Nov 1 and pagebio 1.2-1.6M/day at 1-3% verified. Single-click + dp-spoof 295k on Oct 30 at 55% verified, 118k on Nov 1 at 7%.
Highlight AI Chat Prompt: grease/pagebio 860k on Oct 31, 465k on Nov 1, 0-1% verified.
Roblox Login (Key 1): webgl 228k on Oct 31 at 0% verified; dishort300 + ja4 40k on Oct 31.
Microsoft Identity Signup: webgl ~70-90k/day at 0-1% verified.
Blizzard ROW Support Site: grease 11-31k/day at 0% verified.
Expedia EG Taap LowTraffic (Key 3): grease 48k-101k/day; got through on Oct 29-30 (75-96% verified) and fell to 6-11% on Oct 31 - Nov 1; OS-spoofing family 9k on Nov 1 at 57%.
Airbnb Account Lookup: grease/pagebio 43-69k/day Oct 29-31 at 0-15% verified, stopped Nov 1.
Chime Login (Key 1): ends-te + dp-spoof 9-13k/day Oct 31 - Nov 1 at 16-26% verified.
Bank of America Beacon ATM keys again: AuthHub Key 3 (519C70B3) ends-te 5k/day at 0% verified, and CashPro Key 5 (B993C75A) in discovery. Same pattern as Beacon Workforce Key 4 last week.
Tinder PreSMS: OS-spoofing family 1-5k/day at 79-96% verified (getting through).
gtop100: single-click 25k on Nov 1 at 97% verified; grease 36k at 72%.
Adobe Sign Up: grease 28k on Nov 1 at 43%; pagebio 10k at 49%; ends-te 3k at 83%.
Adobe ARP FF: webgl 17-33k/day at 54-68% (1% on Nov 1).
All dict-3 combos are 0 since Oct 27 (DI dictionary flags disabled, revert not yet done).
Roblox Game Join ends-te (55k on Oct 27 -> 0); Roblox Login spoofed-OS wave (974k on Oct 28 -> ~4k/day); Airbnb on Nov 1; Adobe Commerce webgl (22k -> ~0).

sections.h: Discovery (Oct 29 - Nov 1): 2 new candidates, validated, not created
items: g-rfc-ct-before-cl-di-short-300-pxr1: 8 keys, exact share 0.86, 4.59M sessions, 34% verified. Uber SMS 2.81M (46% verified; its NO-THREAT hits share JA4 with the bot-classified ones), Highlight AI 695k, Amazon IDS 446k, Roblox Monetization 201k (95% verified, may be benign), Expedia, Airbnb, MS Signup.

g-device-param-spoofing-di-high-risk-sig-st-4x: 8 keys, share 0.67, 1.19M sessions, 14% verified. Amazon IDS 413k, Roblox Login 163k, Airbnb, BofA Beacon Workforce, DoorDash, Roblox Game Join, Expedia, Chime. Includes DI flags, so it will jump when the DI revert lands.

Dropped as artifacts: the new g-atm agent telltales (created Oct 29), cdn single-cookie, timezone (DST) family, ja4-dict-1 step, wired velocity, Ensemble lists, dict-7/15/31 (re-thresholded Oct 27). DI revert not done yet; none of the CHNGE-6738 parents exist yet.
